description: File: pkix-path/src/lib.rs in PolicyMappings step(d) has_any check. When a mapping's issuerDomainPolicy is not already in the tree at cert_depth and the code looks for anyPolicy at cert_depth (has_any check), it should check cert_depth-1 (the parent level) per RFC 5280 §6.1.4(b)(1)(ii). Verify line in the find_cert_ext call for anyPolicy in the mappings fallback, then check against RFC text and PKITS §4.10 results.
